summary: GTJ REIT, Inc. disclosed on Form 8-K that on June 3, 2026, it redeemed 76,365 shares at $26.19 per share for $2 million aggregate consideration under its Amended and Restated Share Redemption Program. Demand exceeded the program's annual $2 million cap, so redemptions were prorated (with priority for death/disability). The cap being met halts further redemptions until the next semi-annual period beginning December 1, 2026. This is a periodic issuer capital return feature, not an extraordinary event. Unsatisfied requests carry over. Watch for future cap adjustments or program modifications if demand persists.
